overview: Cross-reference to a 1937 Canton telegram: the Bank of Taiwan was transferring Canton/Swatow silver to China's Central Bank.

people.name: Linnell
people.role: Sender of the referenced telegram from Canton

subfiles.title: Cross-reference to Linnell telegram on Bank of Taiwan silver holdings
subfiles.about: The sheet refers to a telegram reporting the planned transfer of the Bank of Taiwan's silver holdings in Canton and Swatow to the Central Bank of China.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to a Canton telegram: the Bank of Taiwan was transferring silver to China's Central Bank, press-reported and Japanese-confirmed.

interest: Tracks a 1937 Bank of Taiwan silver-transfer report.
